chunks: These are the verses of the Scripture. Whatsoever is sent down to you from your Lord is the truth; but most men do not believe.
ai.seo_question: What does the verse 'Alif Lam Mim Ra' signify in Surah Ar-Ra'd?
ai.summary: In the Shia tradition, this verse underscores the concept of *al-Haqq* (absolute truth) as the intrinsic nature of the Quran, contrasting it with the spiritual blindness of the majority who reject divine guidance despite its clarity. It highlights the epistemological gap between those who possess *'ilm* (knowledge) and those who merely follow *zann* (speculation), a theme central to Shia exegesis regarding the authority of the Imams as interpreters of the divine word.
